name: weighted pinch block lift
description: Pick up a loaded pinch block with one hand, squeezing it between thumb and fingers. It trains pinch strength with a load that is simple to track and increase.
instructions: Choose a block width that suits the pinch you want to train, and load it.
Set it on the floor or a low box beside you.
Bend your knees and hips, keep your back flat and grip the block with your thumb on one side and your fingers on the other.
Stand up with a straight arm, lifting slowly so the block stays level.
Lower it slowly under control, then switch hands after the set.
